governing_line: the soft layer must never contain driving logic — it only points at the engine. Slash commands are the seam. One surface, two callers.
what: The conductor binding's whole surface, declared as DATA: thirteen independent studs, each exactly one cellctl subcommand (C1), no orchestration sequence anywhere in this layer (C8). A new stud = a new row here, zero re-authoring of the seam or the firmware. The orchestration METHOD (which commands, in what order, under what soft config) is never in this table — it lives in the brick data the engine reads (scenario + spec + soft config).

cellctl.note: env-only config; the extension's ONLY subprocess is this binary (K1). HERDR_BIN is declared beside it (see src/cellctl.mjs) and read by no code path — the binding never shells to the platform CLI.

serialization: every cellctl report is forwarded byte-for-byte: the binding re-serializes nothing, never normalises (K2); exit 0 = the declared success status, any other exit is carried as an error with the raw report text — INCONCLUSIVE never reads clean (C6).

tools.name: word
tools.label: Word
tools.description: Decode a scenario file — the word over the desks and its signed paths — through cellctl word (one call). Returns the decode report verbatim; absent/empty/malformed reads its honest status with the reason, never a substituted value.
tools.promptSnippet: Decode a scenario word through the seam
promptGuidelines: Use word when a scenario file (or inline scenario JSON) must be decoded before planning.

params.name: scenario
params.description: the scenario file path (or omit and pass json)

params.name: json
params.description: the scenario as inline JSON (an alternative to the file path)

tools.name: plan
tools.label: Plan
tools.description: Derive the sign-walk of an already-DECODED scenario through cellctl plan (one call, pure — no socket, no ledger). The scenario argument is a JSON file holding word.decode_scenario's "scenario" object.
tools.promptSnippet: Plan a decoded scenario's sign-walk through the seam
promptGuidelines: Use plan over a decoded scenario file — plan never re-decodes the raw word.

params.name: scenario
params.description: a JSON file holding the decoded scenario

tools.name: materialize
tools.label: Materialize
tools.description: Emit (or with verify=true read back) a decoded word's child cells through cellctl materialize (one call). out is the output directory; visits optionally carries a plan report's visits list.
tools.promptSnippet: Materialize a decoded word's cells through the seam
promptGuidelines: Use materialize with a decoded scenario and an output directory; use verify=true to read the materialized word back instead of emitting.

params.name: scenario
params.description: a JSON file holding the decoded scenario

params.name: out
params.description: the output directory

params.name: visits
params.description: a plan JSON (navigate.plan_walk report) covering the loop-expanded visits

params.name: verify
params.description: read the materialized word back instead of emitting

tools.name: conduct
tools.label: Conduct
tools.description: The composite run — the load-bearing stud. Conduction = call conduct; the conductor never re-derives the walk. One cellctl call binds the engine's own orchestrate.main over the cell spec (data); the binding adds no sequence of its own (C8). With plan_only=true and a scenario path it makes the declared decode+plan pair, byte-identical to the direct calls (C3). The seam's run lock is inherited by construction (C5).
tools.promptSnippet: Run the conducted cycle through the seam
promptGuidelines: Use conduct for the composite run over the live desks — one call, never a hand-built walk.
Use conduct with plan_only=true when only the plan is wanted (decode + plan, no run, no lock).

params.name: spec
params.description: the live cell spec (spec.json — the declared data)

params.name: max_steps
params.description: the caller's step budget (overrides the spec's)

params.name: plan_only
params.description: decode + plan only — no run, no lock (C3)

params.name: scenario
params.description: with plan_only=true: the scenario file to decode + plan

tools.name: walk
tools.label: Walk
tools.description: The raw sign-walk over the live wiring (one call: the engine's navigate.walk over the attested live world). The low-level surface — conduct is the composite that also emits boot/steps/run-end.
tools.promptSnippet: Walk a decoded word against the live wiring through the seam
promptGuidelines: Use walk for the raw per-step trace; prefer conduct for the composite run.

params.name: spec
params.description: the live cell spec

params.name: max_steps
params.description: the caller's step budget
